Name: EmotionFramework
Author: slpOff
Description:
Emotion Framework

Overview

Emotion Framework gives every NPC a [b]dynamic mood system[/b] — each day, NPCs start with a random emotional state that affects their dialogue, gift reactions, and interactions with the player.The system creates more organic relationships: some days they’re cheerful and open, others they might be tired, shy, or annoyed.It’s designed to work alone or as a foundation for other mods that add new emotions, portraits, or behaviors.[line]For Players


How It Works[list]
[*]Every morning, each NPC receives a random [b]emotion[/b] (e.g. Good, So-so, Bad, Funny, Shy).
[*]Emotions directly influence dialogue tone and gift responses.
[*]Hover your cursor over an NPC and press [b]Z[/b] to display their current mood portrait and icon.
[*]Mood changes reset daily, but mod packs can override or control them dynamically.
[/list]Example Behaviors[list]
[*][b]Good[/b]: Higher friendship gain from gifts and conversations.
[*][b]So-so[/b]: Neutral; acts normally.
[*][b]Bad[/b]: Easier to upset; dislikes hit harder.
[*][b]Funny[/b]: Finds odd gifts less offensive.
[*][b]Shy[/b]: Prefers conversations to gifts that day.
[/list]Installation[list=1]
[*]Install the latest [b]SMAPI[/b] version.
[*]Place the [code]EmotionFramework[/code] folder inside your [code]Mods[/code] directory.
[*](Optional) Add any content packs that define new emotions.
[/list]Compatibility[list]
[*]Fully compatible with Stardew Valley 1.6 and SMAPI 4.x+.
[*]Other mods can expand this system using the provided API.
[*]Content Patcher packs can use the built-in [code]"Emotion"[/code] token in dialogue or event conditions.
[/list][line]For Modders


Purpose

Emotion Framework is built to let modders [b]add emotional states, alter NPC behavior[/b], and integrate emotions into dialogues, events, or friendship logic.
It exposes a simple API and a flexible JSON-based content pack format.Main Features[list]
[*][b]Public API[/b] — read and modify emotions via [code]GetEmotion(npcName)[/code] or [code]SetEmotion(npcName, emotionId)[/code].
[*][b]Content Pack Support[/b] — easily define new emotions through JSON files.
[*][b]Content Patcher Token[/b] — automatically exposes [code]"Emotion"[/code] as a token for conditional logic.
[*][b]Automatic Effects[/b] — emotions influence friendship gain, gift reaction, and dialogue responses automatically.
[/list][line]Example Content Pack

[b]Folder Structure[/b][code]Mods/ └─ EmotionFramework/
└─ EmotionFramework_ExtraEmotions/
├─ manifest.json
├─ emotions.json
└─ assets/icons/
├─ sleepy.png
├─ angry.png
└─ flirty.png

[/code][b]manifest.json[/b][code]{

"Name": "Emotion Framework - Extra Emotions",
"Author": "slO", "Version": "1.0.0",
"Description": "Adds new emotions for the Emotion Framework mod.",
"UniqueID": "slO.EmotionFramework.ExtraEmotions",
"ContentPackFor": { "UniqueID": "slO.EmotionFramework" }

}
[/code][b]emotions.json[/b][code]{

"Sleepy": {
"Id": "Sleepy",
"DisplayName": "Sleepy",
"GiftMultiplier": 0.8,
"DialogueMultiplier": 0.7,
"HateGiftExtraMultiplier": 1.2,
"PortraitIndex": 3,
"IconPath": "assets/icons/sleepy.png"
},

"Angry": {
"Id": "Angry",
"DisplayName": "Angry",
"GiftMultiplier": 0.6,
"DialogueMultiplier": 0.5,
"HateGiftExtraMultiplier": 1.5,
"PortraitIndex": 5,
"IconPath": "assets/icons/angry.png"
},

"Flirty": {
"Id": "Flirty",
"DisplayName": "Flirty",
"GiftMultiplier": 1.3,
"DialogueMultiplier": 1.5,
"HateGiftExtraMultiplier": 0.8,
"PortraitIndex": 2,
"IconPath": "assets/icons/flirty.png"
}

}
[/code]This file defines new emotions, their behavior multipliers, and optional portrait index or icon.
Modders can include as many custom states as they like.[line]Extension Points

[b]1. EmotionManager API
[/b]
Other mods can access the EmotionManager through the mod registry to get or set emotions dynamically.[b]2. Content Packs
[/b]
Add new moods by shipping an [code]emotions.json[/code] file and optional icons or portraits.[b]3. Portrait Renderer
[/b]
The built-in HUD system displays emotion portraits and icons above NPCs when pressing [b]Z[/b].[b]4. Content Patcher Integration
[/b]
Use emotions in conditional logic with:[code]"When": { "Emotion": "Good" }[/code][line]Technical Notes[list]
[*]Requires [b]SMAPI 4.0 or later[/b]
[*]Built on [b].NET 6.0[/b]
[*]Uses [code]IClickableMenu.drawTextureBox()[/code] for dialogue-style frames
[*]Portraits are automatically cropped using [code]PortraitIndex[/code]
[*]If a portrait is missing, only the icon is rendered above the NPC
[/list][line]Suggested Uses[list]
[*]Emotion-specific dialogues or events
[*]Gifts that change meaning depending on mood
[*]Custom portrait variations per emotion
[*]Mood-based friendship systems
[/list][line]License & Credits

Emotion Framework is an independent open mod framework.
It can run on its own or alongside other mods that build upon it.
Feel free to create and publish content packs or API integrations — just credit the original framework in your description.
